result.instructions: Tools for Mistral, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Mistral data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run mistral_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run mistral_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run mistral_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. mistral_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: mistral_list_models
tools.title: List models
tools.description: List every model available to your account — Mistral base models plus your fine-tuned models. Management API: GET /v1/models.

tools.name: mistral_get_model
tools.title: Get a model
tools.description: Retrieve details for a single model (base or fine-tuned). Management API: GET /v1/models/{model_id}.

model_id.description: The model id, e.g. mistral-large-latest or a fine-tuned model id.

tools.name: mistral_list_files
tools.title: List files
tools.description: List uploaded files belonging to your organization (fine-tune data, batch inputs/outputs, etc.). Management API: GET /v1/files.

purpose.description: Filter by purpose, e.g. fine-tune, batch.

source.description: Filter by source, e.g. upload, mistral.

sample_type.description: Filter by sample type, e.g. instruct, batch_request.

tools.name: mistral_get_file
tools.title: Get a file
tools.description: Retrieve metadata about a specific uploaded file. Management API: GET /v1/files/{file_id}.

tools.name: mistral_get_file_url
tools.title: Get a file download URL
tools.description: Get a temporary signed download URL for an uploaded file. Management API: GET /v1/files/{file_id}/url.

tools.name: mistral_list_batch_jobs
tools.title: List batch jobs
tools.description: List batch inference jobs for your organization and user, with optional filters. Management API: GET /v1/batch/jobs.

status.description: Filter by job status, e.g. QUEUED, RUNNING, SUCCESS, FAILED, CANCELLED.

created_after.description: ISO 8601 date-time; only jobs created after this time.

created_by_me.description: If true, only jobs created by the current user. Default false.

tools.name: mistral_get_batch_job
tools.title: Get a batch job
tools.description: Retrieve details and status for a single batch job. Management API: GET /v1/batch/jobs/{job_id}.

tools.name: mistral_list_agents
tools.title: List agents
tools.description: List agent entities in your account, sorted by creation time. Management API: GET /v1/agents.

tools.name: mistral_get_agent
tools.title: Get an agent
tools.description: Retrieve a single agent entity with its configuration. Management API: GET /v1/agents/{agent_id}.

tools.name: mistral_list_libraries
tools.title: List document libraries
tools.description: List RAG document libraries you own or that have been shared with you. Management API: GET /v1/libraries.

page_token.description: Continuation cursor from a previous response's next_page_token.

search.description: Case-insensitive search on the library name.

tools.name: mistral_get_library
tools.title: Get a document library
tools.description: Retrieve details about a single document library. Management API: GET /v1/libraries/{library_id}.

tools.name: mistral_list_library_documents
tools.title: List documents in a library
tools.description: List the documents uploaded to a given document library. Management API: GET /v1/libraries/{library_id}/documents.

tools.name: mistral_create_agent
tools.title: Create an agent
tools.description: Creates a Mistral Agent (additive configuration). Management API: POST /v1/agents. Requires model and name; instructions, tools, completion_args, description and handoffs are optional.

model.description: Model powering the agent, e.g. mistral-large-latest.

instructions.description: System instruction prompt the agent follows.

tools.description: Tools available to the agent (passthrough objects, e.g. {type:'web_search'}).

completion_args.description: Completion arguments (temperature, top_p, etc.) as a passthrough object.

handoffs.description: Agent ids this agent may hand off to.

tools.name: mistral_cancel_batch_job
tools.title: Cancel a batch job
tools.description: Cancels a running Mistral batch job — stops processing and further billing for that job. Management API: POST /v1/batch/jobs/{job_id}/cancel.

job_id.description: The batch job id (UUID) to cancel.

tools.name: mistral_delete_file
tools.title: Delete a file
tools.description: Permanently deletes an uploaded file from Mistral. Destructive. Management API: DELETE /v1/files/{file_id}.
